<!-- pr-reviewer: 2aa9ea562f0dac82e9ad9cffee144aee79ea745a -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The fix is one routing line in `feature_routed` (`crates/ui/src/interact.rs:151`). It agrees with `op_pick_locked` (`interact.rs:105`), which already treats an armed Boundary row as a pick mode, and with `feature_click::ask`, which already takes faces and edges for an armed row in every mode (#1727).
- The row's lifecycle already clears `boundary_pick` when the group closes or the page changes (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/boundary.rs:65,75,190,310` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:101`), so the new route cannot strand a click away from the model picker.
- The two pinning tests drive real viewport clicks through the shell's own route, not a direct `take_pick` call. The file has its provenance line and its Gate map.
- `docs/decisions/3335-do-not-touch-pick.md` records the decision and the dropped options. It is new in this PR; it is not on `main`.
- No toolpath, posting or collision path changes. Degenerate routing states (disarmed, locked tab) keep the old behaviour.

## Results

Built on the self-hosted runner (macOS): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45014924751 - trial merge with `main` at `62353ac75`, clean, merged.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate, 13 steps | 12 ok, 1 FAIL (below) |
| Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The one FAIL is `egui_app::post_dialog_tests::desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably`. That is the known main red tracked as #3384: it fails on `main` itself at `b6a3e7c6b` and later (post-merge run 45013041231), an ancestor of the merged main. It is not caused by this PR; a fix is in flight.

Re-checked locally (Windows) on the same merged tree, to get a PR-attributable result:

- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1428 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored. The one failure is the same #3384 test, at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tests.rs:69`. No other test fails.
- The two pinning tests pass: `do_not_touch_takes_viewport_clicks_in_models_mode` and `do_not_touch_takes_a_face_and_an_edge_by_viewport_click`.

Heavy check: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main` - the diff reaches no heavy lane.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The body says "No screenshot: the page layout did not change." The layout is unchanged, but the standing order for UI PRs asks for a before/after viewport shot in the body. A short capture of a face click adding a row with "Click selects" on Models would close that. This does not block the technical verdict.
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` is 1842 lines, well past the ~400-line guideline. Pre-existing; this PR adds 6 lines. Worth a future split, not here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
